_format: see gt_scenario.py docstring; ls/rs = [t, x, y] (x right, y forward), *_polar = [t, deg, mag] (0 = forward, + = clockwise/right), lt/rt = [t, v]; times relative to step start; undefined channels keep the previous step's final value
_bindings: Pad mapping under InputSchemesMode=Alternative (verified in game 2026-10-23): L3 (LS) tap = sprint, R3 (RS click) TAP 0.08 s = crouch toggle (crouch_fraction 1.0; an R3 hold 0.35 s did not toggle), B = Dodge (a B hold 0.35 s never crouched: 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-23 runs); camera speed depends on the game's pad sensitivity (camera_whip_180 rs durations are a starting point, calibrate with the cam= yaw in the trace)
_pose_limits: optional per scenario: "pose_limits": {"<column of the pose meter row>": 400} (a maximum) or {"<column>": {"max": 400, "min": 0, "max_vs_baseline_pct": 20}}; checked on the scenario window <name>#<run> by night.py (pose meter) and gt_posemeter.py; none configured = report only; columns: see gt_posemeter.window_row

slow_walk_half_stick.description: half-stick slow walk 0.40-0.55 for 6 s, then stop

run_arc_left.description: full-stick run, stick rotating left at 60, 90 then 120 deg/s

run_arc_right.description: full-stick run, stick rotating right at 60, 90 then 120 deg/s

slalom_stick.description: run with the stick swinging +-45 deg every second (2 s period), then stop

flick_180_walk.description: walk (|stick| 0.45) forward, stick reversed through centre in 0.1 s, walk back, stop

flick_180_run.description: run (full stick) forward, stick reversed in 0.1 s, run back, stop

flick_180_sprint.description: sprint (full stick + L3 tap) forward, stick reversed in 0.1 s, stop

camera_whip_180.description: run forward, right stick full right ~0.6 s (about 180 deg camera turn, sensitivity dependent), run on, whip back left, stop

crouch_walk_turns.description: crouch (R3 tap 0.08 s, one toggle; Alternative input scheme), crouch-walk forward, arc right then left at 90 deg/s, stop, uncrouch (one toggle), stand check; FAILs with 'crouch not engaged' / 'crouch not released' when MMTRACE loco is not 2 / 1

sprint_start_stop.description: sprint start from idle (stick 0->1 in 0.15 s + L3), stop by release, then a run start/stop

idle_then_start_sideways.description: idle 3 s, quick start right, stop, start left, stop, start backwards, stop

sprint_dash.description: sprint (full stick + L3), then dodge/dash taps of B while moving (forward, left, right, back) and a sprint stop; pad dodge = Dodge_Button IK_Pad_B_CIRCLE (inputUserMappings.xml), fired by IsActionJustTapped(n"Dodge") with move input (locomotionTransitions.script:286); B is Dodge under the Alternative input scheme too (crouch = R3 tap since 2026-10-23)
sprint_dash._note_thresholds: The motion data has no dash clips yet, so a dash is played with start and turn clips: up to 3.75 transitions/s accepted until dash clips exist

kbd_taps.description: keyboard-like input: full forward presses of 0.25 - 1.0 s with instant edges (key taps), then rest

kbd_switch_90.description: keyboard-like input: run forward, then instant switches right, back, left, forward (one key released, the next pressed), stop

kbd_switch_180.description: keyboard-like input: instant reversals forward / back and left / right at run speed

kbd_diagonals.description: keyboard-like input: a second key added or released at full deflection - forward, forward+right, right, back+right, back, back+left, left, forward+left, forward

kbd_strafe_weave.description: keyboard-like input: forward held with the left / right key alternated every 0.4 s (weaving run), then pure left / right alternation every 0.35 s

kbd_mouse_turns.description: keyboard-and-mouse-like input: forward held while the camera turns steadily right, then left, then two quick camera flicks; stop

weapon_draw.description: weapon macro part (night.py): draw = Y TAP (SwitchItem_Button IK_Pad_Y_TRIANGLE); a Y HOLD opens the weapon wheel (seen 2026-10-07 06:04) - never hold Y

weapon_aim.description: weapon macro part (night.py): walk armed, aim (LT = RangedADS_Button IK_Pad_LeftTrigger) for 2 s while walking slowly, stop; no firing

weapon_holster.description: weapon macro part (night.py): holster = DOUBLE TAP Y (two 0.08 s taps 0.15 s apart; like Alt on keyboard)

weapon_walk.description: weapon macro part (night.py): walk unarmed after holstering, stop

melee_face_forward.description: enemy macro part (night.py): a short forward nudge turns the body to the camera direction before a target is placed, then V stands

melee_draw.description: melee macro part (night.py): unarmed RT TAP (attack, 0.15 s) raises the fists; then 1.2 s idle (mask on reasons=0x1 expected in the UTPP log). Pad RT = attack; needs verifying on this profile

melee_punch.description: melee macro part (night.py): standing, 3 x RT tap 0.15 s, 0.7 s apart (start to start); MM weight must stay 1.00 while the upper-body mask is on

melee_punch_walk.description: melee macro part (night.py): left stick forward 0.5 (walk) with 2 RT taps 0.15 s - leg slip check (legs from MM while the arms punch), then stop

melee_block.description: melee macro part (night.py): block = LT held 2.0 s standing (MeleeBlock; mask reasons 0x1 expected), release, 0.6 s idle

melee_holster.description: melee macro part (night.py): same input as weapon_holster = DOUBLE TAP Y (two 0.08 s taps 0.15 s apart) to lower the fists; no aliasing in the scenario format, so a copy

melee_punch_look_up.description: melee full body + aim tilt (2026-11-09): fists drawn by the RT tap (attack when already drawn), right stick up 0.4 s (camera pitch up; calibrate with the camera pitch in the trace), 3 x RT tap 0.15 s standing, then the camera back down. UTPP log (mm.trace on): 'MMMELEEFULL on why=on' after the first punch, 'MELEEAIM src=cam' with pitch > 0 (<= maxUp 20, flags 0x1 when clamped), MM weight 1.00

melee_punch_look_down.description: melee full body + aim tilt (2026-11-09): as melee_punch_look_up with the right stick down 0.5 s (camera pitch down): 'MELEEAIM' pitch < 0 (>= -maxDown 35, flags 0x2 when clamped), legs on the game pose ('MMMELEEFULL on'), no foot slide

melee_block_look_down.description: melee full body + aim tilt (2026-11-09): fists drawn, camera pitched down (right stick down 0.5 s), block = LT held 2.0 s standing (mask reasons 0x1, 'MMMELEEFULL on', 'MELEEAIM' pitch < 0), release, camera back up

melee_punch_then_walk.description: melee full body -> upper-body mask transition (2026-11-09): fists drawn, 2 standing RT taps (full body: 'MMMELEEFULL on'), then left stick forward 0.5 (walk) with 2 more RT taps: 'MMMELEEFULL off why=speed' once the capsule passes 0.6 m/s, legs fade back to MM in 0.2 s (no pop, no foot skating), stop, idle

aim_probe_hold.description: aim_probe macro part (night.py): LT (aim) ramps to 1 at 0.2 s and is held until 4.0 s, RT taps (shots, 0.15 s each) at 1.5 s and 2.5 s, stick zero; utpp_probe AimProbe logs samples/shots meanwhile. Needs the weapon drawn (V holds a pistol on the test profile)

wheel_probe.description: night.py recovery probe: short walk forward (movement expected in MMTRACE / NightPos); no movement -> a menu or the weapon wheel is open

veh_call.description: vehicle macro part (night.py): D-pad right tap = CallVehicle_Button IK_Pad_DigitRight (fallback when the CET spawn did not produce a vehicle)

veh_enter.description: vehicle macro part (night.py): X tap = Choice1 IK_Pad_X_SQUARE (interaction 'Enter')

veh_drive.description: vehicle macro part (night.py): RT throttle 3 s, release, LT brake 1.5 s, release

veh_exit.description: vehicle macro part (night.py): B hold 1.0 s = ExitVehicle_Button IK_Pad_B_CIRCLE (last resort: cycle 4 B hold 0.8 s never exited; keyboard F tap / F hold come first)

shoulder_swap_input.description: Pad R3 held 0.7 s swaps the UTPP camera shoulder (UTPP log 'shoulder -> left (pad)' then 'shoulder -> right (pad)'); R3 tapped 0.08 s keeps the game's R3 action (Alternative scheme: crouch toggle) and adds no 'shoulder ->' line

mw_light_combo.description: melee weapon macro part (gt_melee_weapons.py): standing, 5 RT taps 0.15 s, 0.65 s apart (start to start) = the light combo to its last strike, then 0.7 s idle

mw_guard_idle.description: melee weapon macro part (gt_melee_weapons.py): standing, no input for 2.5 s (the weapon rests in its guard / idle pose)

mw_strong_attack.description: melee weapon macro part (gt_melee_weapons.py): standing, RT held 1.2 s (strong / charged attack), released, 1.8 s idle

mw_sprint_attack.description: melee weapon macro part (gt_melee_weapons.py): sprint (full stick + L3 tap), one RT tap while sprinting, then stop

mw_light_combo_fast.description: melee weapon macro part (gt_melee_weapons.py): standing, 8 RT taps 0.12 s, 0.30 s apart (start to start) = clicks early enough to be buffered during each strike (the game switches to the next strike at the recover start), so the combo runs to its last strike whichever strike length the weapon has; then 1.6 s idle. The slower cadence is mw_light_combo

jump_in_place.description: state scenario (set states): stand 2 s, one A tap (Jump_Button IK_Pad_A_CROSS) = a jump in place, 1.5 s air phase (not scored), 3 s landing and standing (scored with the default limits); the stick is never touched

jump_running.description: state scenario (set states): full-stick run 2 s, one A tap while running = a running jump, 1.6 s air phase (not scored), 2 s run on after the landing, stop 2.5 s (scored with the default limits); no sprint (no L3)

slide_sprint.description: state scenario (set states): sprint 3 s (full stick + L3 tap), R3 tap while sprinting = slide (Alternative scheme: ToggleCrouch / Dive = R3; the game needs >= 4.5 m/s, stick within 45 deg of the facing) with the stick held 2.6 s (slide, exit into the crouch; not scored), stick released and 1.5 s crouched (not scored), R3 tap = stand up (not scored; the steps named pad_* keep their R3 press as a pad press: never replaced by the keyboard crouch key, never skipped with --background), 2.5 s stand check: FAILs with 'stand not reached after the slide' when MMTRACE loco is not 1 (an R3 toggle parity error: the slide did not leave V crouched)

stand_check.stand_fraction.msg: stand not reached after the slide

weapon_fire.description: weapon macro part (night.py weapon_macro fire=True; set states): standing, aim (LT = RangedADS_Button IK_Pad_LeftTrigger) held 1.2 s, three single shots (RT = RangedAttack_Button IK_Pad_RightTrigger, 0.1 s taps, 1.2 s apart), aim released; the weapon must be drawn (weapon_draw) and hold ammo; no stick

weapon_reload.description: weapon macro part (night.py weapon_macro fire=True; set states): standing, X tap 0.12 s = Reload_Button IK_Pad_X_SQUARE (X is also the interaction button: not next to a car or a door), then 6.7 s of waiting so a slow reload has ended; the magazine must not be full (weapon_fire spent shots)
